en: The postcard depicts a scenic, elevated hilltop with several buildings and a prominent tower at sunrise. The path leading up to the summit is winding, and several people are visible walking. The hill is lush green, and the sun is rising on the left-hand side. The text is in German and describes the location as 'Die Schneekoppe bei Sonnenaufgang, 1605 m ü. M.', which translates to 'The Schneekoppe at sunrise, 1605 meters above sea level.'
